en: Colorized vintage view over a river with a stone bridge leading into a small European town. The riverside is lined with trees and houses with red-tiled roofs, and church towers rise above the town skyline. In the foreground on the grassy riverbank, there appear to be laundry or textiles laid out to dry. The sky is blue with scattered clouds. The printed caption in the upper left reads "Rochlitz i. Sa."
